enterprise_context.main_business: The company manufactures precision mechanical components for industrial equipment. Factory engineers and line supervisors maintain CNC machines, inspection devices, and assembly lines. Staff need to quickly search maintenance manuals, SOPs, troubleshooting notes, past incident reports, and quality-control procedures.
constraints: the system must not make final safety decisions
the system must not instruct staff to bypass safety interlocks
the system must not approve machine restart after a serious alarm
human supervisor approval is required for safety-critical, quality-critical, or production-impacting actions
the system must cite document evidence or say when evidence is missing
the system should answer in clear Japanese and optionally simple English for trainees

selected_scaffold.purpose: Retrieve knowledge, summarize evidence, draft grounded answers, and flag uncertainty.

llm_app_design_summary.reason_for_scaffold_selection: The knowledge_assistant scaffold aligns with the need for a chat-based interface to retrieve, summarize, and cite evidence from technical documents, manuals, and incident reports. It supports Japanese and simplified English for trainees, flags uncertainty, and integrates human-approval requirements for safety-critical actions.

product_requirements.problem_statement: Troubleshooting equipment alarms and finding maintenance procedures
product_requirements.proposed_capability: RAG-powered QA over maintenance manuals, alarm codes, and incident reports, with source citations
core_workflows: Capture user preferences, constraints, and business context.
Rank local workflow candidates and implementation options with deterministic tools.
Ask DeepSeek to draft a Japanese recommendation using only local tool results and evidence.
Block external sending until a human reviewer approves the packet.
acceptance_criteria: The app exposes a real CLI and local web UI.
The backend includes separate agent, tool, data, guardrail, and API modules.
Recommendations use concrete candidate names from the selected domain template.
The system never returns send_allowed=true in the local product runtime.
Candidate examples are loaded from template data, e.g. 業務候補 1, 業務候補 2, 業務候補 3.
non_goals: No production database or external CRM integration in the local product runtime.
No automatic customer sending or irreversible action.
No legal, financial, disaster-safety, or investment guarantee.
product_requirements.safety_policy: Human approval is required before customer-facing, financial, legal, safety, or operationally consequential use.

production_gaps.production_requirement: Add login, role-based access, approval-owner identity, and session audit trails.
Replace local JSON files with a real database, migrations, and backup/restore policy.
Connect to approved internal document stores, CRM/SFA, ticketing, property systems, or maintenance logs.
Add structured logs, latency metrics, model cost metrics, tracing, alerts, and redaction.
Add threat model, rate limiting, prompt-injection tests, dependency scanning, and data-retention controls.
Add approval queue, edit history, reviewer comments, and final approval records.

recommended_next_milestones: Pilot with sanitized enterprise data and named reviewers.
Add authentication, persistent storage, and approval workflow.
Connect to real enterprise data sources behind read-only permissions.
Add monitoring, cost controls, security tests, and prompt-injection evaluation.
Run 50-100 human-reviewed cases before production rollout.
